title: Pan-Seared Fish in Papillote with Winey Glaze
description: A flavorful and moist fish dish, Italian-style, cooked in a flavorful papillote with a sweet and sticky winey glaze.

ingredients.name: fish (4 fillets)
ingredients.notes: fresh fish (such as salmon or tilapia)

ingredients.name: gooeey sauce
ingredients.notes: sweet and sticky sauce (such as honey or maple syrup)

ingredients.name: brazilian spices
ingredients.notes: paprika, garlic powder, or other spices of choice

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.notes: olive oil or other neutral-tasting oil

ingredients.name: papillote
ingredients.notes: four small pieces of parchment paper or aluminum foil

instructions: Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Heat a tablespoon of oil in a hot skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the winey and gooey ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until the glaze is smooth and bubbly.
Place the fish in a papillote with the glaze and serve immediately.
